snippet.title: [PS1] Linda Cube Again - RPG from Alfa System
snippet.description:
Linda Cube Again is a Playstation remake of a PC-Engine CD role-playing game Linda Cube. 

The world of Neo-Kenya is on the brink of destruction, threatened by a giant asteroid. You follow the story of Ken and his childhood friend Linda on a mission to capture a pair of every living creature on the planet and evacuate on the spaceship Astroark before the calamity strikes. 

Despite what it may appear to be on the surface, Linda Cube is one of the most eclectic and bizarre games in existence with a narrative that blurs the lines between horror and comedy, drama and absurdity. Spread across the game's several scenarios are the most unlikely of personalities, events and occurrences you'll ever encounter in a Japanese RPG. A giant space ark? A cult of demented Santa Claus worshippers? Adolph Hitler as a mad scientist? Pokemon-style monster collecting? - That's Linda Cube!!!

The Playstation remake features improved audio and visuals as well as over twenty minutes of anime cutscenes. The Saturn version which came out later removes some of the censorship present on the PS1.
